[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of healthy lunch recipes for meal prep, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Quinoa Salad Jars: Ingredients include 1 cup quinoa, 1 cup mixed greens, 1 cup cherry tomatoes, 1/2 cup cucumber, 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese (optional), 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley, and 2 tbsp. olive oil and lemon juice dressing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Grilled Chicken and Veggie Containers: Ingredients include 1 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast, 1 cup mixed veggies (bell peppers, zucchini, carrots, broccoli), 1/2 cup brown rice or quinoa, and 1 tbsp. olive oil and salt and pepper to taste.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Lentil Soup: Ingredients include 1 cup cooked lentils, 1 cup diced veggies (onions, carrots, celery), 2 cups vegetable broth, 1 can diced tomatoes, 1 tsp. cumin and paprika, and salt and pepper to taste.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Chicken and Avocado Salad: Ingredients include 1 lb. cooked chicken breast, 1 ripe avocado, 1 cup mixed greens, 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes, 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro, and 2 tbsp. olive oil and lemon juice dressing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Roasted Veggie and Brown Rice Bowls: Ingredients include 1 cup cooked brown rice, 2 cups mixed roasted veggies (sweet potatoes, Brussels sprouts, cauliflower), 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley, and 2 tbsp. olive oil and salt and pepper to taste.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Turkey and Cheese Wraps: Ingredients include 1 lb. sliced turkey breast, 1 cup mixed greens, 1/2 cup sliced cucumber, 1/4 cup sliced cherry tomatoes, 1 tbsp. hummus, and whole wheat tortilla.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Quesadilla Stuffed Bell Peppers: Ingredients include 4 bell peppers, 1 cup cooked brown rice, 1 cup black beans, 1/2 cup diced veggies (onions, bell peppers), 1/4 cup shredded cheese, and 1 tbsp. olive oil and salt and pepper to taste.
